payload.summary: Completed and published requested roadmap, alternatives backlog and initial no-training Laya pilot. Remote results commit 727ab9d; CI 37581338247 passed Windows, Linux and macOS including offline validation of every prediction. All 96 rows, probabilities, two protocols and excluded Windows setup failure retained. Configured laya-pilot check passed stable source/intent snapshot 1128d123f3c34faa486798c7fa9f68a277d98718d8faeab3e7b43dcee279ec65. Multilingual checkpoint exact-identity precision 30.7% (23 true / 75 suggested), recall 95.8%, 52 false identities; not ready for automatic merging under tested schema. No fine-tuning or production semantic/Git integration performed. Model study and alternatives task remain open for broader comparison/adaptation.
payload.next: Publish final ledger validation only. Further model comparison/training should retain this pilot unchanged and use independent project/time test splits.
